name: Asian supermarket
address: 45 Wellington St, Bodorp, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Authentic Asian supermarket and eatery in George serving fresh ingredients and home-style Eastern dishes.
description_long:
Tucked away on Wellington Street in Bodorp, this Asian supermarket doubles as a welcoming spot for genuine Eastern flavours. The shelves are stocked with imported ingredients from across Asia, while the modest kitchen turns out home-style dishes that keep regulars coming back for their noodle and rice bowl fixes.

The atmosphere is no-frills and practical – more about substance than setting. It's the kind of place where you can grab your soy sauce and fresh veg, then sit down for a quick lunch of stir-fry or curry made with the same quality ingredients lining the aisles. Perfect for anyone craving proper Asian cooking in George, or needing specialty groceries for their own kitchen experiments.

Convenient for takeaways and a lifeline for home cooks hunting down that specific sauce or noodle variety. The staff know their stock and can point you toward whatever you're after, whether it's for eating in or taking home.
